scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Kkkkkkkkk!
I have a special event this Halloween that tests your luck and agility.
Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
Kkkkkkkkk!
万圣节期间我有一个特别活动，考验你的运气和敏捷。
你有兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Come on! Don't be a wuss!
If you collect enough tickets you can get good prizes!
So what do you say?
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
来吧！别这么胆小！
收集足够的门票就能获得不错的奖品！
那么，你愿意试试吗？

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
You a 'fraidy cat or something?!
You know you want to try again...
Do you know the rules?
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
你该不会是胆小鬼吧？！
你明明还想再试一次...
你知道规则吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I know.
scripts.translation: 知道。

scripts.text: No, I don't know.
scripts.translation: 不知道。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Oh, well done! You are alright!
Isn't it fun with zombies??
You know, zombies were people too!
Ha!
Kkkkkkk.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
哦，干得漂亮！你很不错！
和腐尸一起是不是很刺激？
要知道，腐尸以前也是人呢！
哈！
Kkkkkkk.

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
As I promised
You can get Halloween tickets for cool items.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
如我所承诺的，
你可以用万圣节门票兑换不错的物品。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Well, do you want to hear the rules again or, just get back to it...
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
那么，你是想再听一遍规则，还是直接开始...

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
This village is like a virtual Payon.
There are zombies and ghouls roaming around and three southern exits, but only one works.
That's up to you to find out.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
这个村庄就像虚拟的斐扬。
到处游荡着腐尸和绿腐尸，有三个南方的出口，但只有一个能通行。
具体是哪个，得靠你自己去发现。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
You can't use any skills to kill the ghouls or zombies.
And one more thing...
you shouldn't forget...
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
你不能使用任何技能来杀死绿腐尸或腐尸。
还有一件事...
你不应该忘记...

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
All participants should be wearing nothing.
Put all belongings in your storage and come back here when your weight is '0'.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
所有参与者都必须不穿任何装备。
把所有物品存入仓库，当你的负重为“0”时再回来。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Oh and one more thing!
You can't be riding a PecoPeco or have a Cart.
If you are, then I will remove them before you enter.
Got it?
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
哦，还有一件事！
你不能骑着大嘴鸟或拥有手推车。
如果你有的话，我会在你进入前移除它们。
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Remember, there are three exits but only one works randomly, the zombies and ghouls roaming around there can't be killed and you can't be wearing anything.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
记住，有三个出口但只有一个随机可用，游荡的腐尸和绿腐尸无法被杀死，而且你不能穿戴任何装备。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Hey...
Come back once you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
嘿...
准备好了再回来。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Ok, you are ready.
Let me check your weight.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
好，你准备好了。
让我检查一下你的负重。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Gosh!
There's always a black sheep anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
天哪！
哪里都有害群之马。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
You think I wouldn't notice that your weight is above '0'?
You're overweight...
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
你以为我没注意到你的负重超过“0”吗？
你超重了...

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
You seem good to go, and your weight is just right.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
你看起来状态不错，负重也刚刚好。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
I was quite swamped with my work, so I'm exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
我工作太忙了，所以很疲惫。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
I sometimes forget to send you there...
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
我有时会忘记把你传送过去...

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
I hope you come back well.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
希望你能平安回来。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
You want to exchange tickets for prizes?
Good job! Kkkkkk!
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
你想用票券兑换奖品吗？
干得不错！Kkkkkk！

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Lemme tell you what items you can exchange for.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
让我告诉你可以用票券兑换哪些物品。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
5 tickets for Pumpkin Pie.
20 tickets for Pumpkin-Head.
50 tickets for Old Blue Box.
70 tickets for Old Purple Box.
200 tickets for Old Card Album.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
5张票券兑换南瓜派。
20张票券兑换南瓜帽子。
50张票券兑换神秘箱子。
70张票券兑换神秘紫箱。
200张票券兑换老旧 收集册。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
What would you like to exchange for?
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
你想兑换什么？

scripts.text: Pumpkin Pie
scripts.translation: 南瓜派

scripts.text: Pumpkin-Head
scripts.translation: 南瓜帽子

scripts.text: Old Blue Box
scripts.translation: 神秘箱子

scripts.text: Old Purple Box
scripts.translation: 神秘紫箱

scripts.text: Old Card Album
scripts.translation: 老旧 收集册

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Ok, see you then.
Kkkkkkkk.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
好的，到时候见。
Kkkkkkkk。

scripts.text: Explain it to me.
scripts.translation: 给我解释一下。

scripts.text: I want to participate.
scripts.translation: 我想参加。

scripts.text: I want to exchange tickets for prizes.
scripts.translation: 我想用票券兑换奖品。

scripts.text: I'll come back next time.
scripts.translation: 我下次再来。

scripts.text: Get me back there now!
scripts.translation: 现在就把我送回去！

scripts.text: Please, tell me the rules
scripts.translation: 请告诉我规则

scripts.text: I want to exchange tickets for prizes.
scripts.translation: 我想用票券兑换奖品。

scripts.text: I'll come back next time.
scripts.translation: 我下次再来。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
You don't have enough tickets!
Can't you even count?
Please come here with the right number of tickets.
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
你的票券不够！
你连数数都不会吗？
请带着正确数量的票券再来。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Here it is.
Do you need...
anything else?
scripts.translation:
[万圣节魔法师]
给你。
还需要...
别的吗？
